parameters.query: SELECT s.id, s.signal_type, s.signal_category, s.title, s.summary, s.severity, s.confidence_score, s.source_name, s.source_url, s.detected_at, s.keywords, s.affected_regions FROM signals s WHERE s.detected_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '{{ $json.lookback_hours }} hours' AND s.severity IN ('critical', 'high', 'medium') ORDER BY CASE s.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 END, s.confidence_score DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT t.id, t.trend_name, t.trend_category, t.summary, t.momentum_score, t.direction, t.signal_count, t.first_detected, t.last_updated FROM trends t WHERE t.last_updated > NOW() - INTERVAL '{{ $json.lookback_hours }} hours' AND t.is_active = true ORDER BY t.momentum_score DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ce.competitor_name, ce.event_type, ce.title, ce.description, ce.severity, ce.source_url, ce.detected_at FROM competitor_events ce WHERE ce.detected_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '{{ $json.lookback_hours }} hours' ORDER BY CASE ce.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, ce.detected_at DESC LIMIT 10
